parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The enthalpy change of solution, $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{sol}}$, of the Group 2 sulfates becomes more endothermic down the group.

State and explain the trend in the solubility of the Group 2 sulfates down the group.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Write the expression for $K_{\text{w}}$, the ionic product of water.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The numerical value of $K_{\text{w}}$ increases with increasing temperature.

Place a tick (✓) in the appropriate column in each row to show the effect of increasing the temperature of water on the pH and on the ratio $[\text{H}^{+}]:[\text{OH}^{-}]$.

| effect of increasing temperature of water | decrease | stay the same | increase |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| pH |  |  |  |
| ratio $[\text{H}^{+}]:[\text{OH}^{-}]$ |  |  |  |

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide has a pH of 13.25 at 298 K.

Calculate the concentration of this sodium hydroxide solution.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Buffer solutions are used to regulate the pH of a solution to keep its pH value within a narrow range.

Write **two** equations to describe how hydrogencarbonate ions, $\text{HCO}_{3}^{-}$, and carbonic acid, $\text{H}_{2}\text{CO}_{3}$, control the pH of blood.

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem: The $K_{\text{a}}$ for ethanoic acid is $1.75 \times 10^{-5} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{ K}$.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text:
When ethanoic acid is dissolved in water, an equilibrium mixture containing two acid-base pairs is formed.

Write an equation for this equilibrium. In the boxes label each species acidic or basic to show its behaviour in this equilibrium.

$\text{CH}_{3}\text{CO}_{2}\text{H} +$ [ ] $\rightleftharpoons$ [ ] + [ ]

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
A buffer solution was prepared by adding $30.0 \text{ cm}^{3}$ of $0.25 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ ethanoic acid, an excess, to $20.0 \text{ cm}^{3}$ of $0.15 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide.

Calculate the pH of the buffer solution formed at 298 K. Give your answer to **one** decimal place.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.text: Use the titration curve for reaction **M** to deduce the volume of acid added at the end-point for this titration.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
The table shows some acid-base indicators.

| name of indicator | pH range of colour change |
| :--- | :--- |
| malachite green | 0.2-1.8 |
| bromocresol green | 3.8-5.4 |
| bromothymol blue | 6.0-7.6 |
| thymolphthalein | 9.3-10.6 |

Name a suitable indicator for each of the acid-base titrations **M** and **N**. Explain your answers.
